content: The Prototipo RS - Red/Black/Orange shoes offer all-day comfort and versatility. They feature extra padding on the tongue, heel, and collar, an ONSTEAM anti-microbial lining for moisture and odor control, and a removable cork and EVA foam insole with a perforated footbed.
